title: Supporting Each Other
grammar: Reflexive support verbs (gondoskodik, támaszkodik, ragaszkodik); segítenek egymásnak, számítanak egymásra
goal: I can talk about caring for, relying on, and being attached to someone with gondoskodik, támaszkodik and ragaszkodik.
I can say that people help and count on each other using segítenek egymásnak and számítanak egymásra.
I can use four new words for support and trust in a relationship.
I can describe how two people support each other.
